crossRefs.note: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.
I will give thanks to Yahweh with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.
I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.
For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
Now therefore, our God, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.
Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.
I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
Teach me, Yahweh, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.
Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.
The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.
Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths.
Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.
Good and upright is Yahweh, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.
Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by…
It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has…
You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.
crossRefs.keyword: thy righteous judgments. Heb. judgments of thy righteousness

translations.web: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.
translations.bsb: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
translations.kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.
translations.asv: I will give thanks unto thee with uprightness of heart, When I learn thy righteous judgments.
